fastp 0.20.1
Licence: MIT (LICENSE in this folder)
Upstream source: https://github.com/OpenGene/fastp/tree/v0.20.1
WebAssembly build: Biowasm (https://biowasm.com/), downloaded from
  https://biowasm.com/cdn/v3/fastp/0.20.1/ on 2026-10-01
Build recipes: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm (a pinned copy is in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)

Local change to the JavaScript loader: exit(status) is recorded as Module.__exitStatus, so that the
terminal of the practical keeps the exit status of a failed command.
Modified file: fastp.js
fastp.wasm and fastp.data are unmodified.

Known difference from a native 64-bit build of the same version: the reads that fastp writes and
its filtering numbers are identical (checked with -w 1); the estimated duplication rate differs
slightly (7.16 % here, 6.98 % native for the course data). The estimate comes from a hash table,
and this is a 32-bit build.
